Esercizio Esteso Multi-Agent AI Research System
===============================================

This documentation covers the Esercizio Esteso project, a multi-agent AI research system 
built with CrewAI that provides intelligent routing between specialized research crews 
for documentation, web search, and mathematical problem-solving capabilities.
